name: gluestack-ui
summary: Universal copy-paste UI for React and React Native with NativeWind/Tailwind.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 40+ documented components from the public sitemap.
gluestack-ui v5 (`npx gluestack-ui@latest`) targets Expo/React Native; Next.js web support is not current on v5 — use v4 docs for Next until NativeWind v5 web lands.
LICENSE file lives at packages/gluestack-ui/LICENSE (root LICENSE 404); npm @gluestack-ui/core also MIT.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Accessible pressable button with text, icon, spinner, and group.

demo.peerNotes: CLI copies into @/components/ui; GluestackUIProvider required after `npx gluestack-ui@latest init`. v5 targets Expo/RN; Next.js → v4 docs.

components.copyCode:
npx gluestack-ui@latest init
npx gluestack-ui@latest add button

import { Button, ButtonText } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use gluestack-ui free MIT React/React Native component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://gluestack.io/ui/docs/components/button. Initialize with `npx gluestack-ui@latest init`, then `npx gluestack-ui@latest add button` (copies into `@/components/ui/button`). Docs: https://gluestack.io/ui/docs/home/getting-started/installation. Home: https://gluestack.io. Repo: https://github.com/gluestack/gluestack-ui.
